title: OpenAI Annual Revenue Exceeds $40 Billion, Surges Over 20% MoM in July

content_html:
The highly anticipated OpenAI is accelerating its plan to go public in the United States later this year, with widespread expectations that its valuation could break through the one trillion dollar mark. As the capital market focuses heavily on it, this leader in the artificial intelligence field has delivered an impressive financial performance.

According to internal documents, OpenAI's annualized revenue has officially surpassed 40 billion US dollars, doubling from the end of last year. In just the past July, its monthly revenue saw a more than 20% month-over-month growth, demonstrating a very strong momentum in commercial expansion. At the same time, its main competitor Anthropic also plans to proceed with an IPO this year. Previously, it had announced that its annualized revenue reached 47 billion US dollars in May. However, due to differences in accounting practices between the two companies, it is difficult to directly compare their financials.

Looking back at recent business developments, OpenAI's rapid revenue growth mainly stems from the simultaneous progress of multiple product lines. Not only has the revenue from its core paid subscription layer continued to rise, but its early advertising business has also gradually become profitable. In the enterprise market, the platform's Codex coding agent and enterprise collaboration tools have received widespread market recognition. To consolidate its market share in the competitive industry, OpenAI has also flexibly adjusted its pricing and market strategies, lowering the prices of some models to attract cost-conscious developers.

Despite its rapid commercialization, OpenAI has also experienced some personnel turbulence recently. The departure of its former Chief Revenue Officer Denise Dresser initially raised concerns about the future performance of its corporate business. However, the company quickly completed the transition, with Dali Rajic, who previously worked at the cybersecurity giant Wiz, taking over the new position. As two leading AI companies move toward the capital market, whether this aggressive growth model can continue under the backdrop of significant capital expenditures and intense R&D efforts will become an important indicator for Wall Street to observe the development of the industry.

content_html_zh:
备受期待的OpenAI正在加速今年晚些时候赴美上市的计划，外界普遍预期其估值可能突破万亿美元大关。 在资本市场的高度关注下，这家人工智能领域的领军企业交出了令人瞩目的财务业绩。

据内部文件显示，OpenAI年化收入已正式突破400亿美元，较去年年底翻倍。 刚刚过去的7月份，其月收入环比增长超过20%，商业扩张势头十分强劲。 与此同时，其主要竞争对手Anthropic也计划在今年进行IPO。 此前，其曾宣布5月份年化营收达到470亿美元。 然而，由于两家公司会计实务的差异，很难直接比较它们的财务状况。

回顾近期的业务发展，OpenAI营收的快速增长主要源于多产品线的同步进展。 不仅核心付费订阅层收入持续上升，早期广告业务也逐渐盈利。 在企业市场，该平台的Codex编码代理和企业协作工具获得了市场的广泛认可。 为了巩固在竞争激烈的行业中的市场份额，OpenAI还灵活调整了定价和市场策略，降低了部分型号的价格，以吸引注重成本的开发者。

尽管商业化速度很快，但OpenAI最近也经历了一些人事动荡。 其前首席营收官丹尼斯·德莱瑟(Denise Dresser)的离职最初引发了对其企业业务未来业绩的担忧。 不过，该公司很快完成了过渡，此前在网络安全巨头 Wiz 工作的达利·拉吉奇 (Dali Rajic) 接任了新职位。 随着两家领先的人工智能公司走向资本市场，这种激进的增长模式能否在巨额资本支出和密集研发力度的背景下持续下去，将成为华尔街观察行业发展的重要指标。
